description: Golden dataset for the candidate inbox triage tool. 'sample' goldens mirror data/messages.csv (M041 is excluded: its empty body is rejected by the loader before any model sees it). 'holdout' goldens are new messages that are not in the sample inbox, so prompt changes cannot be tuned against them by accident. policy_refs point at policy_excerpts, which must appear verbatim in policies/recruiting_policy.md (checked by check_goldens.py).

policy_excerpts.no_decisions: Never share hiring decisions, interview feedback, rankings, or information about other candidates by message. Decisions and feedback come from the assigned recruiter directly.
policy_excerpts.follow_up: The drafting tool cannot see application records, interview calendars, or offer status. When an answer depends on them, say that the recruiter will check and follow up within 2 business days.
policy_excerpts.review_window: We aim to review every application within 10 business days of submission.
policy_excerpts.confirmation_email: Every application submitted through the careers portal receives an automatic confirmation email; if it did not arrive, the recruiter will check that the application was received.
policy_excerpts.move_application: A candidate may move an existing application to a different open role; the recruiter arranges this, so a second application is not needed.
policy_excerpts.calendar_invite: Interview times are set by the recruiter, who sends a calendar invite containing the Google Meet link.
policy_excerpts.no_times: A reply must never propose or confirm a specific date or time; the recruiter confirms times by calendar invite.
policy_excerpts.reschedule: Candidates may reschedule once with at least 24 hours' notice. Requests with less notice (for example emergencies) are reviewed case by case by the recruiter.
policy_excerpts.process: Process for most roles: recruiter screen (30 minutes), skills interview (60 minutes), final panel (60–90 minutes).
policy_excerpts.dress_code: Dress code for onsite interviews is business casual.
policy_excerpts.upload: CVs and portfolios can be uploaded on the careers portal (careers.brightpath.example) or sent as a PDF attachment in reply to this inbox.
policy_excerpts.upload_fails: If the portal upload fails, use a PDF under 5 MB, or attach the file to a reply instead.
policy_excerpts.photo_id: Candidates attending a final-round onsite interview bring a government-issued photo ID.
policy_excerpts.offer_stage_docs: Transcripts and references are requested only at offer stage.
policy_excerpts.no_pii: Never ask for or accept national ID numbers, bank details, or passwords by email. If a candidate sends them, ask them not to send such details by email, say the message will be deleted from the inbox, and explain that the secure onboarding portal is used after an offer.
policy_excerpts.no_salary: Do not state salary figures or ranges, and do not negotiate by message. The recruiter will arrange a call to discuss compensation.
policy_excerpts.offer_letters: Offer letters are emailed by the recruiter after approval.
policy_excerpts.withdrawal: Confirm the withdrawal, thank the candidate, and say they are welcome to apply again in future.
policy_excerpts.data_deletion: Candidate data is kept for 12 months after the process ends. Candidates can ask for deletion at any time; deletion is completed within 30 days.
policy_excerpts.hybrid: Most roles are hybrid: 3 days per week in the Lahore or Karachi office. The recruiter confirms the arrangement for a specific role.
policy_excerpts.no_visa: Brightpath does not currently sponsor work visas.
policy_excerpts.open_roles: Open roles are listed on the careers portal.
policy_excerpts.benefits: Benefits: health insurance for the employee and immediate family, 20 days of paid annual leave, and an annual learning budget.
policy_excerpts.adjustments: Brightpath provides reasonable interview adjustments (for example captions, written components, extra time, flexible scheduling).
policy_excerpts.people_team: Requests are passed confidentially to the People team, who will contact the candidate. Do not ask for medical details.
policy_excerpts.complaint_escalation: Concerns about interview conduct are taken seriously and escalated to the Head of Talent, who will contact the candidate within 5 business days.
policy_excerpts.complaint_tone: Acknowledge and thank the candidate. Do not argue, speculate, or admit fault on behalf of individuals.
policy_excerpts.not_candidates: Sales pitches and unrelated messages: draft a one-line polite note that this inbox handles candidate enquiries only.

Honestly I enjoyed that part much more than the sales side. When I saw the Sales Associate opening at Brightpath I applied because I really like what your company does and I thought any role would be a good way in. But since then I noticed you also have an HR Coordinator opening, which matches my recent experience much better. I don't want to seem indecisive and I am still happy to be considered for sales if that is the only option. I also wasn't sure whether applying twice would look bad, or whether my existing application could simply be moved. My manager has agreed to give a reference whenever needed. Anyway, sorry for the long message, I just wanted to explain my thinking properly. Thank you for reading.
